MRI Information
The Iris Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. A person with the Iris Coronary Stent System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Iris Coronary Stent System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T or 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 2,500 G/cm (25 T/m)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions For 1.5T MR Scanner: maximum B1+rms of 2.8 μT; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg
For 3T MR Scanner: B1+RMS of 1.2 microtesla or less; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 1.5 W/kg
Scan Duration at 3T: Scan for up to 15 minutes.
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 5 mm from the device.
